name: Temporal Distortion
summary: Words fall slower for a while.
description: Words fall slower for 8 seconds. Each cast adds its own slow: two at once are slower still.

name: Frostbinding
summary: Freezes words 8 s; perfect words build Focus.
description: Freezes every word in place, and stops new words appearing, for 8 seconds. You can keep typing, and Volley time keeps running. Frostbound Focus: each perfectly typed word during one freeze adds +2, +4, +8, then +8 Combo instead of +1. A typo breaks the Focus run (and, as always, the Combo). Focus resets when the freeze ends. Casting again while frozen adds time, less each cast (8 s, 5.6, 3.9 …), and keeps the Focus run going.

name: Arcane Shield
summary: Blocks 2 misses, or saves Combo from slips.
description: Adds 2 shield layers. A layer is spent when a word reaches the ward line (it does no harm), or when you make a typo and fix it: your Combo and Volley are kept. That corrected word still isn't perfect, so it adds no Combo and never counts for Ice Focus. One layer covers every slip in one entry. Lasts until the end of the level.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: Strikes the lowest word; may chain onward.
description: Always strikes the lowest word. From each struck word, lightning may leap to nearby words: closer words are likelier, and each leap makes the next less likely (seeded, so a replay strikes the same way). Up to 10 words. Struck words count toward the level and pay base points × your Combo (× All-In if active). Shock never adds Combo or Volley. The odds are provisional.

name: Transmutation
summary: Shortens long words; they keep full value.
description: Every word of 6+ letters becomes a 2–3 letter word, for good, and still pays the original word's full base points when you type it. Then, for 8 seconds, every new word is short and easy (2–3 letters, no rare letters or names). It earns Combo and Volley only the normal way, by typing.

name: Incineration
summary: Burns the low field; flames spread through crowds.
description: Every word in the lower half of the field ignites, and flames leap to any word close enough to a burning one, generation after generation. Words in the top fifth are always spared. Each burned word pays its base points, +25% per generation of spread (a crowded field burns further and pays more). No Combo, Volley or level progress. Combustion Chain is a provisional prototype.

name: Arcane Purge
summary: Mends the Ward, or wagers All-In at full.
description: Below your Ward's current maximum, Wind heals it back to that maximum and removes the extra speed your mistakes gave words. At your current maximum, Wind goes ALL-IN: the Ward drops to 25%, its maximum is scarred (−15, then −20, −25 …), and for 10 seconds your typed words, Harvest and Shock score ×2. A Ward breach ends All-In (in Hardcore any mistake does), and healing with Wind ends it too. You can wager again whenever you're back at your maximum, as long as it would stay at 40% or more. Normal clears scars each level; Hardcore keeps them for the whole stage. Prototype values.

name: Harvest
summary: Claims every word, cashing in Combo and Volley.
description: Claims every word on the field: they all count toward the level and pay their full base points × your Combo multiplier × your active Volley multiplier (× All-In if active). Your Combo stays; your Volley is spent. Harvest never adds Combo or Volley captures.
